UFS 4.1 introduces Host-Initiated Defragmentation (HID). After 6 months of heavy recording + deletion on a long-soak device, the read-tail latency has grown:

  p99 random-read latency: 2.1 ms → 8.7 ms

We want to trigger HID periodically during device idle. What sysfs controls enable and trigger HID (hid_enable, hid_progress), what are the failure modes (FM-UFS41-HID-Timeout) if the device refuses, and how do we avoid running HID on a device already in a critically worn state? Is HID safe to run while the camera is recording?
